title: Oven Roasted Spanish Rice Paella
description: A roasted, dense, and light Spanish dish featuring rice and syrup, diabetic-friendly and made with double-rise-bread, cooked in a slate-tile vessel.

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the Spanish rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken and spices.
Transfer the mixture to a slate-tile vessel and add the jocheong syrup, double-rise-bread, and lemon juice.
Cover the vessel with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the bread is toasted.
Remove the vessel from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let the paella rest for 5 minutes before serving.
